l.i: Ceu gemma luces splendida. Non tuis Nisi eminentes verticibus duces, Regesque sublimi canuntur Pectine, Pierioque versu.
HENRICVS ingens Borbonidũm decus, Qui nunc potitus Francide Celtica, Tumultuoso victor instans Tecta quatit Parisina bello.
CONDÆVS hinc & Bullonij duo, Haud bruta Martis fulmina, cum stetit Fortuna, fortunaeq; vertex Ante alios niveus videri.
ELISA demum, virgo Britannica Victrix Iberorum, Oceano in vago Non ante delassata, quam tot Fuderit irrequieta classes, Quot ad ruinam sufficerent gravem, Clademque supremam agminis hostici.
Hæc lectitantem (ô [?] quanta virtus!) Sic stimulant, IACOMOTE, ut hostes Et ipse Iberos frangere persequar,
Et tortuoso involuere gurgiti Spumantis unda, & mersitare Funerea nece Semimauros.

page.notes: Whole page is verse in italic with capitalised openings of stanzas. The "ô" before "quanta" is doubtful and marked [?]. Stanza breaks follow the printed indentation. No marginal notes; faint stains at the lower left and lower margin are not printed text.
